results.title: Mayank Yadav Creates History, Becomes First Player In The World To Achieve Unprecedented Feat
results.description: Mayank Yadav set a unique world record during the series against Zimbabwe. He made a comeback to the national team after two years. He took five wickets in three games, which included the dismissal of Brian Bennett for a golden duck twice.
